name: taskelith
description: Self-hosted software factory for parallel project development. Bootstrap CLI and architecture plan.
author: Petar Nenov

scripts.build: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/generate-contracts.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/build-workspaces.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run check:boundaries && mkdir -p coverage && node --experimental-strip-types --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include='dist/**/*.js' --test-coverage-include='packages/*/dist/**/*.js' --test-coverage-include='packages/*/*/dist/**/*.js' --test-coverage-exclude='**/node_modules/**' --test-coverage-lines=75 --test-coverage-branches=75 --test-coverage-functions=75 --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/lcov.info test/*.test.ts 'packages/*/test/*.test.ts' 'packages/*/*/test/*.test.ts' && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/check-coverage-scope.ts coverage/lcov.info
